response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(l.DNA) as avg_dna, AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALB IS NOT NULL AND l.TP IS NOT NULL THEN l.ALB - l.TP END) as avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: The phrase 'screened with 180 as the total cholesterol cutoff' filters records where T-CHO >= 180 (cholesterol at or above 180). The direction is not explicitly stated.

alternatives.interpretation: The screening criterion is T-CHO <= 180, keeping records with cholesterol at or below 180.
